parsed.explanation: No trans-specific presentation offence, facility ban, or documented police targeting of trans visitors is shown, so this is not a Tier 1/2 case; the same-sex statute is secondary per the rubric. However it is active since 2017 (3 months-2 years), officials defend it on religious grounds, society frames LGBTQ+ people as a threat to family (only 15% positive in 2024), people hide identity, and police/prosecutors refuse to investigate crimes against LGBTQ+ people with no general discrimination protection - societal hostility with thin/no recourse. The uncorroborated prison figure and absent trans-specific violence statistics are not counted as proven. No LGR is a resident gap, not a visitor deduction. Combined active secondary criminalisation, documented hostility and institutional non-protection place it in high/elevated risk, below cases with working remedies.
